verdict.rationale: Conductor is documented only as a proprietary Mac app with first-party cloud workspaces (conductor.build servers); there is no mention of a self-hostable server/core, Docker image, or on-prem deployment option anywhere in the docs, changelog, or API reference. A community comment explicitly contrasts Conductor as not open source ('unlike Conductor is open source' re: Crystal), reinforcing the absence of self-hosting.
